verdict.rationale: Metronome documents webhooks that fire when a threshold is reached, monitoring of active balance, and auto-recharge or gated access when credits run out. Marketing copy mentions a customizable in-product billing dashboard, and high-volume ingestion without pre-aggregation suggests usage data arrives quickly. However, the evidence never explicitly shows real-time current-cycle usage and accrued-cost views for customers and internal teams, or how thresholds are configured. Missing for 10: explicit docs on real-time current-cycle usage and accrued-cost (draft invoice) visibility, documented configuration of threshold and spend alerts, embeddable customer-facing usage dashboard details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
